title: Scenario 9: the same change through REST
task: Make two changes through the REST API instead of the CLI, then prove them from the CLI. Log in, create VLAN 40 named CAMERAS with a POST, set the description of 1/1/4 to `camera 4` with a PATCH, and run `show vlan` through AnyCLI (POST to /cli). Every answer tells you its CLI twin.
hints: `sim rest post /rest/v10.18/login` first. Without a session every call is a 401, as on the box.
Interface names go in the URL encoded: 1/1/4 is 1%2F1%2F4. `sim rest patch /rest/v10.18/system/interfaces/1%2F1%2F4 {"description":"camera 4"}`.
AnyCLI runs only the exact commands `GET /rest/v10.18/cli/commands` lists: `show vlan` is on it, `show vlan 40` is not and answers 403.

checks.desc: It was created with a POST
The description came through a PATCH
